1.english_reference: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah

traditions.WLC: הַ דָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּר֙ יִרְמְיָ֣הוּ הַ נָּבִ֔יא אֶל בָּר֖וּךְ בֶּֽן נֵֽרִיָּ֑ה
traditions.VUL: Verbum , quod locútus est Ieremías prophéta ad Baruch fílium Neríæ ,
traditions.KJV: The word that Jeremiah the prophet spake unto Baruch the son of Neriah ,

1.english_reference: when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah

traditions.WLC: בְּ כָתְב וֹ֩ אֶת הַ דְּבָרִ֨ים הָ אֵ֤לֶּה עַל סֵ֨פֶר֙ מִ פִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ
traditions.VUL: cum scripsísset verba hæc in libro ex ore Ieremíæ ,
traditions.KJV: when he had written these words in a book at the mouth of Jeremiah ,

1.english_reference: in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah

traditions.WLC: בַּ שָּׁנָה֙ הָֽ רְבִעִ֔ית לִ יהוֹיָקִ֧ים בֶּן יֹאשִׁיָּ֛הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה
traditions.VUL: anno quarto Ióakim fílii Iosíæ regis Iuda ,
traditions.KJV: in the fourth year of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah king of Judah ,

2.english_reference: Thus saith the LORD , the God of Israel

traditions.KJV: Thus saith the LORD , the God of Israel ,

3.english_reference: Thou didst say , Woe is me now !

traditions.KJV: Thou didst say , Woe is me now !

3.english_reference: for the LORD hath added grief to my sorrow

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי יָסַ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה יָג֖וֹן עַל מַכְאֹבִ֑ י
traditions.VUL: quóniam áddidit Dóminus dolórem dolóri meo :
traditions.KJV: for the LORD hath added grief to my sorrow ;

5.english_reference: And seekest thou great things for thyself ?

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתָּ֛ה תְּבַקֶּשׁ לְ ךָ֥ גְדֹל֖וֹת
traditions.KJV: And seekest thou great things for thyself ?

5.english_reference: for , behold , I will bring evil upon all flesh , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: כִּ֡י הִנְ נִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא רָעָ֤ה עַל כָּל בָּשָׂר֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: quia ecce ego addúcam malum super omnem carnem , ait Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: for , behold , I will bring evil upon all flesh , saith the LORD :

5.english_reference: but thy life will I give unto thee for a prey in all places whither thou goest

traditions.WLC: וְ נָתַתִּ֨י לְ ךָ֤ אֶֽת נַפְשְׁ ךָ֙ לְ שָׁלָ֔ל עַ֥ל כָּל הַ מְּקֹמ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר תֵּֽלֶךְ שָֽׁם
traditions.VUL: et dabo tibi ánimam tuam in salútem in ómnibus locis , ad quæcúmque perréxeris .
traditions.KJV: but thy life will I give unto thee for a prey in all places whither thou goest .
